import RNA
# Units interact across the A linker. Need stronger separation. The junction closing pairs at 7-35, 37-65, 67-95.
# Full target pairs: 7-35,8-34,10-33,11-32 (outer helix of unit 1, positions 7..35)
# 37-65,38-64,40-63,41-62 (unit 2)
# 67-95,68-94,70-93,71-92 (unit 3)
# So each unit's outer helix IS the junction closing. The single A between units (pos 36, 66) is unpaired linker.
# When assembled, units cooperate. Let me run SA on full length with pair constraints.
import random, math
target='.......((.((.((....)).((...))...)))).((.((.((....)).((...))...)))).((.((.((....)).((...))...)))).......'
pairs=[(7,35),(8,34),(10,33),(11,32),(13,20),(14,19),(22,28),(23,27),
       (37,65),(38,64),(40,63),(41,62),(43,50),(44,49),(52,58),(53,57),
       (67,95),(68,94),(70,93),(71,92),(73,80),(74,79),(82,88),(83,87)]
unpaired=[i for i in range(103) if i not in dict(pairs) and i not in [v for a,b in pairs for v in (a,b)]]
pairset=[('G','C'),('C','G'),('A','U'),('U','A')]
def fold(seq):
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(''.join(seq))
    ss,mfe=fc.mfe()
    return ss
def score(seq):
    ss=fold(seq)
    return RNA.bp_distance(ss,target)
best_global=(999,None)
for restart in range(40):
    cur=['.']*103
    for (a,b) in pairs:
        x,y=random.choice(pairset)
        cur[a]=x; cur[b]=y
    for u in unpaired:
        cur[u]=random.choice('GCAU')
    curd=score(cur)
    bestd=curd; bestseq=cur[:]
    for it in range(8000):
        new=cur[:]
        if random.random()<0.5:
            a,b=random.choice(pairs)
            x,y=random.choice(pairset)
            new[a]=x; new[b]=y
        else:
            i=random.choice(unpaired)
            new[i]=random.choice('GCAU')
        pd=score(new)
        T=2.0*(1-it/8000)+0.01
        if pd<curd or random.random()<math.exp((curd-pd)/T):
            cur=new; curd=pd
            if pd<bestd:
                bestd=pd; bestseq=new[:]
        if bestd==0: break
    if bestd<best_global[0]:
        best_global=(bestd,''.join(bestseq))
        print('restart',restart,'bestd',bestd)
    if best_global[0]==0: break
print('FINAL',best_global)
ss=fold(best_global[1]); print(ss); print(target)
